# Privacy Policy for ChatP2P

**Last Updated: January 31, 2026**

## Introduction

ChatP2P ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.

## Information We Collect

### Information You Provide
- **Username**: A display name you choose (3-20 characters)
- **Messages**: Text, photos, videos, and voice notes you send through the app

### Automatically Generated Information
- **Wallet Address**: A unique cryptographic identifier generated locally on your device
- **Presence Status**: Online/offline status and last seen timestamp

### Information We Do NOT Collect
- Real name or identity
- Phone number
- Email address
- Location data
- Contact list
- Device identifiers for advertising

## How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information to:
- Enable peer-to-peer messaging between users
- Display your chosen username to other users
- Show online/offline status to your contacts
- Deliver messages, photos, videos, and voice notes

## Data Storage and Security

### End-to-End Encryption
All messages are encrypted using AES-GCM encryption before transmission. Only you and your conversation partner can read the messages.

### Firebase Realtime Database
We use Google Firebase to store:
- Encrypted messages
- User profiles (username and wallet)
- Presence information

### Local Storage
Your wallet address and username are stored locally on your device.

## Data Retention

- Messages are stored until you delete the conversation
- Account data is deleted when you delete your account
- Presence data is automatically updated

## Your Rights

You have the right to:
- **Access**: View all your data within the app
- **Delete**: Remove your account and all associated data
- **Portability**: Your wallet address is stored locally

## Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services:
- **Google Firebase**: For real-time messaging infrastructure
- **Apple/Google**: For app distribution

## Children's Privacy

ChatP2P is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Last Updated" date.

## Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
- Email: [your-email@example.com]
